data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Friday, October 9, 2026: Bitcoin, ethereum open at lowest levels in about 3 weeks
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $81,690.49 on Friday, October 9, 2026, down 1.9% from Thursday's open. As of 7:20 a.m. ET this morning, the price of bitcoin jumped to $82,468.42. Ethereum opened at $2,472.47, down 3.9% from Thursday's opening price. The price of ethereum moved up to $2,490.12 as of 7:20 a.m. ET.
